flagged.evidence: The scope says “sideimpermeability needed for monotonicity,” while the Statement concludes only an endpoint inequality when net side flux is zero. In the current draft producer, items/thm-tgr-finite-current-production-balance.md, Proof 4.1, the case a=b=1/4 has positive production 1/2, outward flux 1/4, and positive charge change 1/4; it explicitly says zero side flux is sufficient but not necessary for nondecreasing charge. Thus “needed” overstates the in-scope result.
